title: Store followed by a bounded computation
statement: Let a program, depth bound, initial location map $\ell:\mathbb N\to\mathbb Z$, memory map $\mu:\mathbb N\to\mathbb Z$, expressions $a,e$, statement $s$, time bound $T\in\mathbb N$, and postcondition $Q$ be given. If $s$ can execute from the state with locations $\ell$ and memory updated at address $a(\ell,\mu)$ to value $e(\ell,\mu)$, within time $T-(\operatorname{cost}(a)+\operatorname{cost}(e)+1)$, and end in a state satisfying $Q$, and if $a,e$ are safe in the original state and $a(\ell,\mu)$ is a valid address, then storing $e$ at address $a$ and executing $s$ from the original state ends in a state satisfying $Q$ within time $T$, provided $\operatorname{cost}(a)+\operatorname{cost}(e)+1\le T$.
hypotheses_covered: The following statement $s$ has a $Q$-satisfying execution within the remaining time from memory updated at the evaluated address and value
The address and value expressions are safe in the original state
The store cost is at most $T$
